offres.titre: Management Consultant for Commercial Excellence i Accenture Song
offres.extrait:
Vi søger konsulenter med interesse i Commercial Excellence og GenAI til at blive en del af vores Accenture Song team i København. Vil du være med til at rådgive om og drive digitale transformationer? Trives du i et dynamisk og internationalt miljø? Ønsker du at udvikle din consulting toolbox igennem strategisk rådgivning på komplekse transformationsprojekter?
 Vi leder netop nu efter konsulenter til at blive en del af vores Sales & Service team. Vi fokuserer på at skabe forretningsværdi gennem strategisk rådgivning om CRM-systemer, kundeplatforme og GenAI-løsninger - fra forretningscase og roadmap til realisering - som danner grundlag for virksomhedstransformationer.
 Vi arbejder tæt sammen med vores kunder som betroede rådgivere, der oversætter forretningsstrategi til konkrete initiativer, som kan accelerere virksomhedens vækst og sikre langvarig værdi.
 Som en del af teamet, vil du bidrage til følgende: 
- Du vil deltage i projekter, typisk med roller indenfor forretningsrådgivning, program- og projektledelse samt supportere med forretningsudviklingsaktiviteter
- Bidrage til at ramme de rigtige problemstillinger og rådgive vores kunder i, hvordan de håndterer stigende krav og…

Role: Strategy & Growth Consultant   
 Practice: Accenture Song Service 
 Areas of Work: Customer Strategy & Growth Consultant 
 Level:  9 - Consultant  
 Location:  Dublin, Ireland 
 Years of Exp:  3+ years  
 About Accenture & Accenture Song   
 Accenture is a leading professional services company that provides a wide range of services including strategy and consulting, data and analytics, technology and operation services worldwide. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.   
 Accenture Song is our customer organisation and works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions. We create growth through relevance for our clients and provide a creative playground of imagination and technology. The Service Team is part of Accenture Song and is dedicated to helping clients define, plan and deliver changes that impact end customers and the front-office including:

About the role: 
 As a part of the Global Network-Strategy  team, you will help organizations define and execute enterprise strategies anchored in digital disruption, innovative operating models, and leading industry practices to drive competitive advantage and sustainable growth. “
 Together, let’s enable enterprise innovation , and deliver tangible results and outcomes for our clients. Help us unlock new value in a disruptive world, with the following initiatives:
- Work on projects for Accenture’s key client accounts to develop analysis for C-level client discussions.
- Conduct detailed 360-degree diagnosis of client’s challenges , their market, and the expectations of external stakeholders, to identify the top value creation opportunities that we can help our clients pursue.
- Improve C-suite engagement for our key clients through pro-active trust-based relationships, articulate our unique value proposition, identify big ideas and work across Accenture to deliver breakthrough growth.
- Analyse industry trends, financial data for clients and their competitors.
- Perform industry and competitive strategy analysis along with operating metrics analysis.
